_instructions: Copy this file (e.g. to config.json), fill in your own values, and point Chet at the copy. Never edit this template directly.

capability_map._instructions: One entry per placement-capable capability you want Chet hunting groups for.

scanning._instructions: Where Chet looks for new signals, and the minimum group size to qualify as a cluster.

thresholds._instructions: When a cluster's window counts as closing, in days remaining.

qualification._instructions: Used by cluster-monitoring to decide auto-advancement. Adjust to your own bar.

database._instructions: Wherever you keep cluster records -- Notion, Airtable, a spreadsheet.
database.pipeline_db_id: [YOUR DEALS/PIPELINE DB ID, IF YOU ADVANCE CLUSTERS THERE]
database.contacts_db_id: [YOUR CONTACTS DB ID, IF YOU CHECK FOR A REACHABLE CONTACT]
database.signal_inbox_db_id: [YOUR SIGNAL/INTELLIGENCE INBOX, IF YOU RUN cluster-monitoring]

notifications._instructions: Where Chet reports exceptions and completion summaries.
notifications.webhook_url_env: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the URL itself here]

unmatched_signal_routing._instructions: Where a signal that doesn't match any capability, seen more than once, gets logged.
